# Airwindows (vendored)

Source: https://github.com/baconpaul/airwin2rack, commit `59a227eba3c8b3070abd7f86a28c54685dfa3b76`, files from `src/` only (MIT, see LICENSE.md; Airwindows by Chris Johnson, consolidated by Paul Walker).

478 effects in 22 categories. Left out: category Dithers and ContentHideD, DCVoltage, Monitoring, Monitoring2, Monitoring3, PeaksOnly, SlewOnly, SoftClock, SoftClock2, SoftClock3, SubsOnly, VoiceTrick.

Regenerate with `tools/vendor_airwindows.py <airwin2rack checkout>`; do not edit by hand.
